body:
Follow-up to GH-66259 (the parallel `read_csv` path, unreleased).

A chunk boundary that lands inside a quoted multi-line field makes the chunk before it fail to tokenize (EOF inside string), which fell back to a serial read, but the chunk after it starts mid-quote and fails to convert its misaligned first line under `dtype=` or a raising converter. Whichever worker failed first won, so a valid file could raise `ValueError`.

Any chunk error now stops the remaining workers and the read falls back to serial, which raises its own error if the file is actually bad. That also makes the error deterministic and identical to serial: previously a file with two bad values reported whichever chunk's worker failed first, with row positions relative to the chunk.

No whatsnew: the parallel path has not been released.

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), used to reproduce, write the fix and tests, and review via a parallel-vs-serial differential.
title: BUG: parallel read_csv raised on a quoted newline at a chunk boundary
